initializationAction: q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run function sinnoh:triggers/stopsound');

pages.speaker: npc
lines: ...OK. You win. That was a tough loss. I learned a lot from it. Please, accept this Gym Badge. ' + q.player.username + ' received the Cobble Badge from Maylene. Um... I should explain about that official Pokémon League Gym Badge. With it, you can use the hidden move Fly outside of battle. Oh, and since you now have four Gym Badges, Pokémon obtained in trades will obey you up to Lv. 50. Oh, and please take this as well. That TM60 contains the move Drain Punch. Um... That move inflicts damage, and it robs the target's HP. Gee, I'm hungry... Oh, sorry, it's nothing. I didn't say anything. ' + q.player.username + ', I can't explain what it means to be strong. I don't know how much effort goes into being strong... But being with Pokémon lets us keep making the effort, doesn't it?
